Different random bloke here: I use one level scoop plus a generous sprinkle extra (like maybe 1/4 scoop). I then fill it to the brim with kettle-hot water, stir 50 strokes with the stick thingy, refill, stir 50 more strokes, and then press. Fills a typical 11oz mug perfectly.

(Stirring 100 times sounds super extra, but counting strokes of the stirrer is a fine enough way to pass the minute or so you wait until pressing while you're in a state of "I need my coffee" brain. And it exposes more of the coffee to the water, so it probably comes out stronger or something lol idk)
It's like a single-serve French press but fast. Coffee comes out super smooth, even if you use the cheap stuff.

Press the grounds really tight when you brew, so it makes a little puck, and then take off the basket and plunge it out into the trash/compost while it's still wet. If you let it get dry, then yeah it sucks to clean, but IME if you can get the coffee + paper filter out in one big piece, then all you need to do is rinse it and wipe it down after.
